title: Plaintiff's Motion to Enlarge Time to [ACT]

body.text: Plaintiff [NAME], pro se, moves the Court under Wis. Stat. § 801.15(2)(a) to enlarge the time to [act]. This motion is filed [before the period expires, so the standard is cause shown / after the period expired, so the standard is excusable neglect].
[The facts establishing cause or excusable neglect. Be concrete: what happened, on what dates, and why it prevented timely action.]
[Whether the opposing party objects. If it does not, say so, a non-objection materially shortens the analysis.]

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court enter an order enlarging Plaintiff's time to [act] to and including [DATE], and granting such other and further relief as the Court deems just and proper.
